name: Git & Deployment Pipelines Support for SQL Analytics Endpoint
description: SQL Analytics Endpoint  supports Git integration and deployment pipelines in Fabric. Teams can version control endpoint changes and promote them across environments as part of their existing CI/CD workflows.**Git Integration for SQL Analytics Endpoint** - The SQL Analytics Endpoint changes are tracked, committed, and managed in source control alongside the rest of your Fabric items — giving you full version history, diff visibility, and the ability to roll back to any prior state.**Deployment Pipeline Support** - SQL Analytics Endpoint can be included in Fabric deployment pipelines. Promote changes across development, test, and production stages with the same pipeline experience available for Warehouse — consistently and without manual steps.

result.nameEs: Git y deployment pipelines para el SQL analytics endpoint
result.descriptionEs:
El SQL analytics endpoint admitirá Git integration y deployment pipelines:
* **Git integration:** los cambios del endpoint se versionan junto al resto de elementos de Fabric, con historial, diferencias y posibilidad de volver a un estado anterior.
* **Deployment pipelines:** se podrá promocionar entre desarrollo, pruebas y producción con la misma experiencia que el Warehouse, sin pasos manuales.
